upgrades.name: Return Gate

upgrades.name: Gem Value
upgrades.tooltip: Gems are worth more.

upgrades.name: Plasma Repeater
upgrades.tooltip: The plasma cannon fires at the planet on its own. Until then, click the planet to fire it.

upgrades.name: Mining Laser
upgrades.tooltip: Mounts a mining laser that sweeps the planet and melts gems off its surface.

upgrades.name: Thermal Lance
upgrades.tooltip: Gems melted off by the laser are worth 50% more.

upgrades.name: Twin Lasers
upgrades.tooltip: Adds a second laser beam, doubling the laser's output.

upgrades.name: Rocket Pods
upgrades.tooltip: Fires rocket salvos that blast clusters of gems off the planet.

upgrades.name: Railgun
upgrades.tooltip: Charges up and fires a hypersonic round that throws big gem clusters across the field.

upgrades.name: Max Gem Count
upgrades.tooltip: The most gems the field can hold.

upgrades.name: Expand Space
upgrades.tooltip: Widens the field. Earned for free from prestige talent tiers.

upgrades.name: Gem Synthesizer
upgrades.tooltip: Produces gems every second.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Gems go straight to your balance.

upgrades.name: Ability Point
upgrades.tooltip: Grants one ability point.

upgrades.name: Homebase Collector
upgrades.tooltip: The home base collects gems within its range.

upgrades.name: Homebase Collection Range
upgrades.tooltip: The home base collects from farther away.

upgrades.name: Click Radius
upgrades.tooltip: Clicks collect from a wider area.

upgrades.name: Click Magnetizer
upgrades.tooltip: Clicks pull nearby gems in.

upgrades.name: Unlock Rimrunner
upgrades.tooltip: Unlocks Rimrunners: they circle the edges of the field, collecting gems along the way.
upgrades.tooltip_extra:
Base stats:
Speed: 120
Cargo: 20
Fuel: 100
Refueling: 50

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Count
upgrades.tooltip: More Rimrunners.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Speed
upgrades.tooltip: Rimrunners fly faster.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Capacity
upgrades.tooltip: Rimrunners carry more gems.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Thrusters
upgrades.tooltip: Rimrunners fly twice as fast near the edges.

upgrades.name: Rimrunner Cargo Hold
upgrades.tooltip: Rimrunners have a 15% chance to send a gem straight home without using cargo space.

upgrades.name: Hands-on Harvest
upgrades.tooltip: Gems you collect by hand are worth more.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Applies to clicks, Gem Link and shockwaves.

upgrades.name: Gem Link
upgrades.tooltip: Each click chains to nearby gems and sends them home.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank adds a hop to the next nearest gem.

upgrades.name: Long Reach
upgrades.tooltip: Gem Link jumps farther.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Longer links bridge gaps between clusters.

upgrades.name: Click Combo
upgrades.tooltip: Clicking in quick succession builds a combo that raises click value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Click again within 2 seconds to keep the combo. Up to 10 stacks. Clicks that miss don't count.

upgrades.name: Combo Flow
upgrades.tooltip: More time between clicks before a combo breaks.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: +0.5 seconds per rank.

upgrades.name: Critical Touch
upgrades.tooltip: Clicks can crit for triple value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Rolls once per click. Linked and shockwave gems share the crit.

upgrades.name: Gem Shockwave
upgrades.tooltip: Clicks also sweep up gems around them.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank sweeps up two more gems.

upgrades.name: Synth Overclock
upgrades.tooltip: The Gem Synthesizer pays out more often.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: At +100% the synthesizer pays every half second.

upgrades.name: Tap Dynamo
upgrades.tooltip: Each click speeds up the Gem Synthesizer.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Shown as seconds of synthesis per click. Needs the Gem Synthesizer.

upgrades.name: Sustained Harvest
upgrades.tooltip: Hold the left mouse button to keep collecting.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Repeats every 0.8 seconds and triggers your click upgrades. Also refuels ships under the pointer.

upgrades.name: Pulse Frequency
upgrades.tooltip: Held clicks collect faster.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: At +100%, held clicks repeat every 0.4 seconds.

upgrades.name: Hold Momentum
upgrades.tooltip: Holding speeds up collection for up to five seconds.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Shown as frequency gained per second held. Resets when you let go.

upgrades.name: Gravity Well
upgrades.tooltip: Hold right mouse to aim, then left-click to cast a gravity well that pulls gems in.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Pulls loose gems toward the cast point for 2 seconds. Radius: 3x your click radius. Cooldown: 20 seconds. A red ring means it's still recharging.

upgrades.name: Event Horizon
upgrades.tooltip: A bigger gravity well.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Each rank adds half your click radius.

upgrades.name: Deeper Gravity
upgrades.tooltip: The gravity well pulls harder.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: +15% pull per rank.

upgrades.name: Lingering Singularity
upgrades.tooltip: The gravity well lasts longer.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: +0.5 seconds per rank. The well stays where you cast it.

upgrades.name: Gravity Recharge
upgrades.tooltip: The gravity well recharges faster.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: At max rank the cooldown drops from 20 to 10 seconds.

upgrades.name: Cannon Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: The cannon fires faster.

upgrades.name: Cannon Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: Cannon shots knock more gems loose and reach deeper, more valuable layers.

upgrades.name: Shatter Shells
upgrades.tooltip: Cannon shots break off chunks: each shot's gems land as a cluster.

upgrades.name: Laser Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: The laser melts gems off faster.

upgrades.name: Laser Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: The laser melts more gems loose and reaches deeper, more valuable layers.

upgrades.name: Arc Harpoon
upgrades.tooltip: Anchors a harpoon in the planet. Electric pulses down its cable knock gems loose.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Fire rate shortens both the reload and the time between pulses.

upgrades.name: Harpoon Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: The harpoon reloads and pulses faster.

upgrades.name: Harpoon Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: Harpoon pulses knock more gems loose and reach deeper layers.

upgrades.name: Conductive Barbs
upgrades.tooltip: The harpoon holds for two more pulses.

upgrades.name: Deep Anchor
upgrades.tooltip: Each pulse reaches one layer deeper than the last.

upgrades.name: Forked Current
upgrades.tooltip: Pulses fork and release 50% more gems at a second spot.

upgrades.name: Capacitor Discharge
upgrades.tooltip: The last pulse releases three pulses' worth of gems.

upgrades.name: Tectonic Winch
upgrades.tooltip: Pulling the harpoon out tears off a cluster worth two pulses.

upgrades.name: Rocket Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: Rocket salvos fire more often.

upgrades.name: Rocket Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: Rockets blast bigger clusters and reach deeper layers.

upgrades.name: Rocket Count
upgrades.tooltip: More rockets per salvo.

upgrades.name: Railgun Fire Rate
upgrades.tooltip: The Railgun charges faster.

upgrades.name: Railgun Fire Power
upgrades.tooltip: Railgun clusters hold more gems and reach deeper layers.

upgrades.name: Fragmentation
upgrades.tooltip: The Railgun's impact splits into more clusters.

upgrades.name: Ricochet Rounds
upgrades.tooltip: Cannon shots bounce twice across the planet, knocking 40% more gems loose each time.

upgrades.name: Critical Shells
upgrades.tooltip: 15% of cannon shots crit for five times the gems.

upgrades.name: Magma Scars
upgrades.tooltip: The laser leaves molten scars that keep oozing gems for 4 seconds.

upgrades.name: Overheat Surge
upgrades.tooltip: The laser heats up as it fires. At full heat it melts gems four times as fast, then cools down.

upgrades.name: Cluster Warheads
upgrades.tooltip: Rockets split into three mini-rockets, each blasting off 60% of a rocket's gems.

upgrades.name: Orbital Strike
upgrades.tooltip: Rockets hit the far side of the planet and throw out 25% more gems.

upgrades.name: Tectonic Shockwave
upgrades.tooltip: Railgun impacts send a quake around the planet that sheds half the round's gems.

upgrades.name: Singularity Round
upgrades.tooltip: Railgun rounds collapse into a black hole that tears out as many gems again.

upgrades.name: Fuel Tanks
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet ships fly farther between refuels.

upgrades.name: Tractor Scoops
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet ships collect from farther away.

upgrades.name: Dockside Reclamation
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet ships regain some fuel with every delivery.

upgrades.name: Emergency Autopilot
upgrades.tooltip: Stranded ships start refueling on their own.

upgrades.name: Gatling Cannon
upgrades.tooltip: The cannon fires twice as often.

upgrades.name: Midas Touch
upgrades.tooltip: Gems you collect by hand, gravity well included, are worth three times as much.

upgrades.name: Golden Holds
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet deliveries are worth double.

upgrades.name: Quad Lasers
upgrades.tooltip: Two more laser beams join in: four beams at once.

upgrades.name: Rocket Swarm
upgrades.tooltip: Twice as many rockets per salvo.

upgrades.name: Doomsday Round
upgrades.tooltip: Railgun rounds knock twice as many gems loose.

upgrades.name: Incendiary Warheads
upgrades.tooltip: Rockets leave molten craters that ooze half their gems again over 4 seconds.

upgrades.name: Tesla Coil
upgrades.tooltip: Harpoon pulses arc to every molten scar and crater, knocking gems loose at each.

upgrades.name: Twin Harpoons
upgrades.tooltip: Fires two harpoons at once, over the top and under the bottom of the planet.
